# Pacta by Fractal Neurons — full agent reference (llms-full.txt)

Disambiguation: Pacta by Fractal Neurons (https://pacta.wtf, pacta.base.eth, io.github.Fractal-Neurons/pacta) is the EVM DeFi control-plane, Safe multisig, and timelock verification registry — unrelated to pactaprotocol.org (commercial escrow) or RMI PACTA (climate assessment).

> Pacta by Fractal Neurons (https://pacta.wtf · pacta.base.eth): block-pinned DeFi control-plane observations for AI agents: who can change a protocol's rules (proxy admins, timelocks, Safe quorums, roles), what the docs say, and what is queued. All feeds are free, real-time and read-only; every value replays against any archive node with the given cast command.

Generated deterministically from the feeds below (data as of 2026-11-16T12:32:23Z). 21 sprints · 98 indexed records · 3 queued-operation groups · 10 governance proposals · 5 onboarding briefs.

## Feeds (all free, no key, no paywall)
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/index.json: Block-pinned control-plane index (every record: target, call, block, block hash, classification, Base EAS UID)
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/lookup.json: Protocol / token lookup catalog: 74 protocols + 8 briefs with slug, aliases, checksummed contracts, evidence basis and preflightArgs
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/protocols.json: Every published protocol: badge tier + URLs, evidence basis (62 EAS-attested / 12 RPC-observed), Sprint ids, EAS UIDs, controller, pinned surfaces
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/onboarding.json: Onboarding verification scans: every check with call, calldata, raw result, decoded value; role maps
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/proposals.json: Live governance proposals (Aave, Euler, Morpho, Sky) mapped to block-pinned observations
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/radar.json: Queued timelock operations with on-chain ETAs at a finalized block
- https://pacta.wtf/llms.txt: Short index for language models
- https://pacta.wtf/llms-full.txt: This file: the complete agent reference
- https://pacta.wtf/.well-known/agent.json: A2A Agent Card
- https://pacta.wtf/.well-known/mcp.json: MCP discovery manifest
- https://pacta.wtf/SKILL.md: Portable agent skill

## How to verify any value
1. Take the record's target, call signature and arguments, block number and block hash.
2. Run the listed `cast call … --block N` (or eth_call with EIP-1898 {blockHash, requireCanonical: true}) on any archive node.
3. Run `cast block N --field hash` and compare with the recorded block hash.

## MCP server
- Name: io.github.Fractal-Neurons/pacta · package @pacta/mcp-server v0.1.5 · transport stdio.
- Status: publication_pending: @pacta/mcp-server is not yet published to npm or the MCP registry. Use the remote MCP server now (no install): https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/mcp. The stdio server runs from a clone of the repository: node packages/mcp-server/bin/pacta-mcp.mjs.
- Remote MCP (primary, zero install, Streamable HTTP): https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/mcp · Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http pacta https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/mcp` · MCP client config: {"mcpServers": {"pacta": {"url": "https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/mcp"}}} · remote tools (6 read-only inspection tools + 1 opt-in coverage/feature request tool (pacta_submit_request)): pacta_lookup_protocol, pacta_check_preflight, pacta_scan_control_plane, pacta_scan_timelock_op, pacta_scan_proposal_diff, pacta_get_live_timelocks, pacta_submit_request.
- Local stdio server (from a clone; npm publication pending): `node packages/mcp-server/bin/pacta-mcp.mjs`. OpenAPI 3.1: https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/openapi.json.
- Free MCP tier: tools/call takes three OPTIONAL, non-personal attribution fields: caller_agent (a lowercase slug naming the calling agent, IDE or framework, e.g. claude-code, cursor, coinbase-agentkit; never a name, e-mail, IP, URL, address or secret), requester_role (autonomous_agent | defi_developer | risk_curator_analyst | security_researcher | protocol_team | institutional_allocator | individual_user) and caller_purpose (pre_trade_safety | collateral_due_diligence | yield_allocation | security_audit | governance_monitoring | integration_testing | general_research). Omitted or blank fields never block a call (they count as unspecified); a non-blank invalid value gets JSON-RPC -32602 listing what is allowed. Over REST they are optional query parameters. Location is never asked: only the Cloudflare edge country is counted; no IP is stored.
- One call: `curl -s -A "my-agent/1.0" "https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/check/preflight?chain=ethereum&address=0x..."`. HTTP clients: send a User-Agent (curl -A "my-agent/1.0", or urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "my-agent/1.0"}) in Python): Cloudflare's edge refuses some default library agents with error 1010 before the API answers. Every response carries `assessment` (coverage indexed_verified | unindexed_bytecode_heuristic, confidence high | medium | low, method, limits) next to the 0-100 `riskScore`, plus `catalogMatch` (slug, classification, Base EAS UIDs, pinned block, whatDiffers) when the address is an indexed protocol contract; if live RPC is unavailable for an indexed address, the answer is the pinned catalog record (`source: pinned_catalog_fallback`) instead of a 502.
- 74 indexed protocols: 62 Base-EAS-attested protocols (98 Sprint records across 21 Sprints) + 12 RPC-pinned protocols (not EAS-attested).
- Name lookup first: if you only have a protocol or token name (e.g. Aave, Ethena, USDe, Moonwell, kUSD), call pacta_lookup_protocol (or GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/protocols/lookup?q=<name>) to resolve its verified record: canonical slug and page URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (eas_attested: Base-EAS-attested, documentation compared; rpc_observed: on-chain control plane pinned over JSON-RPC, documentationComparison not_assessed; briefs), and preflightArgs {chain, address} for pacta_check_preflight. 74 protocols + 8 briefs, answered in memory with no RPC; free in every pricing mode; an empty query lists the catalog. Catalog: https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/lookup.json.
- Opt-in demand intake: when a result carries coverage_gap_hint (lookup miss, unindexed or unclassified pre-flight target, unsupported chain), ask the user, then call pacta_submit_request (or POST https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/requests) with the three caller fields, request_type (missing_protocol | unsupported_chain | missing_check_surface | doc_or_data_discrepancy | mcp_or_api_feature), target_subject, requested_capability and urgency_track (community_queue_free | active_due_diligence | issuer_24h_clearance_5k | api_high_volume_sla). It returns request_id (REQ-2026-xxxxxxxx), status (queued | upvoted_existing), demand_votes and fast_track_url; an identical request upvotes the existing one. Free in every pricing mode, 5 per hour; never opens a GitHub issue. contact_handle only when the user explicitly asks for follow-up or an invoice: it is stored privately and never published.
- Bounties ($100): Pacta Chain-Feed Mismatch Challenge, 4 × $25 USDC = $100 USDC hard cap, 7-day sprint Nov 15 – Nov 22, 2026: a verified on-chain control-plane parameter_delta on an unindexed protocol, or live drift on an indexed one, submitted as a PR to Fractal-Neurons/pacta. Paid in USDC on Base Mainnet after maintainer merge (not pre-escrowed): https://pacta.wtf/bounties/
- Bounties Wave 2: 1,000-Gap Perpetual Open-Discovery Program ($1.00 USDC / Merged Net-New Gap on Base), in epochs (Epoch 1 target cap: 25 × $1.00 USDC = $25.00 USDC; $2.00 USDC (2 slots) confirmed unencumbered on-chain now); one merged verified net-new control-plane mismatch per slot: an unindexed protocol (>= $10M TVL), a curated vault (>= $5M TVL), or post-snapshot drift on an indexed protocol; one JSON fixture per PR at bounties/wave-2/<chain>-<slug>.json, checked by CI; paid in USDC on Base within 7 days of maintainer merge in weekly batches to the fixture's basePayoutAddress (not pre-escrowed): https://pacta.wtf/bounties/#wave-2
- Hunter leaderboard: verified catches, protocols covered, Base EAS attestations and settled Base USDC per hunter and agent framework (settled only with a BaseScan payout tx), with README badges at /badges/hunters/<handle>.svg: https://pacta.wtf/leaderboard/
- Community hub (GitHub Discussions): announcements and builder / bounty Q&A at https://github.com/Fractal-Neurons/pacta/discussions; questions about targets, fixtures or the MCP tools go to the Q&A thread https://github.com/Fractal-Neurons/pacta/discussions/44. Wave 2 master issue: https://github.com/Fractal-Neurons/pacta/issues/41
- Vault factories and curators: https://pacta.wtf/integrations/vault-factories/ (Control-Plane & Role Map tab from https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/protocols.json, status badges https://pacta.wtf/badges/<slug>.svg and https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/badges/<slug>.svg, and PactaSentinelGuard.sol: refuses cap increases without a healthy Pacta attestation, never blocks a decrease).
- Stdio tools (10 read-only inspection tools + 1 opt-in request tool):
  - pacta_lookup_protocol (free): Resolve a protocol or token name, symbol, slug or 0x address to its verified record and preflightArgs {chain, address} (query, chain, kind, limit; no RPC)
  - pacta_list_commitments (free): Filter indexed records (protocol, classification, sprint, limit)
  - pacta_get_anchoring (free): Base EAS anchoring: PactaCommitmentRegistry, schema, sprint attestation UIDs
  - pacta_list_proposals (free): Governance proposals feed (forum, topic_id, chain, limit, include_repro)
  - pacta_x402_discover (free): x402 gateway status and discovery manifest (only when PACTA_X402_URL is set)
  - pacta_check_preflight (x402 $0.01): Pre-execution check of a contract: verdict, 0-100 risk score, proxy / admin / timelock, capabilities (chain, address, block)
  - pacta_scan_control_plane (x402 $0.10): Live control-plane scan of a contract (chain, address)
  - pacta_scan_timelock_op (x402 $0.25): Live TimelockController operation state (timelock, opId)
  - pacta_live_timelocks (x402 $0.10): Live state of tracked queued timelock operations
  - pacta_scan_proposal_diff (x402 $0.15): Re-run a tracked governance proposal's pinned reads live, pinned-vs-live diffs (forum, topicId)
  - pacta_submit_request (free): Opt-in (the only tool that writes): queue or upvote a coverage / feature request after a coverage_gap_hint, with the user's consent; forwards to POST /v1/requests (only when PACTA_X402_URL is set)
- Paid tools are disabled unless PACTA_X402_URL is set (opt-in: PACTA_X402_URL=https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev); the client refuses any 402 challenge (v1 body or v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header) whose payTo, asset or network differ from the values below, or whose amount exceeds $1.00 by default. Pay with xPaymentHeader (x402 v1) or paymentSignatureHeader (x402 v2).

## x402 micropayments (optional; only for live scans of unindexed contracts)
- Network: Base (chain id 8453) · scheme exact · asset USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 · payTo 0xcA4E2ff22B69A7284210c47BdeE21Aac1269da09 (attester EOA, pacta.base.eth).
- Pacta Treasury: 0x4348DF1BEFAffcbA248B5118B1b782B1B2bdEd14 (an externally owned account; the PactaCommitmentRegistry treasury slot). Pacta treasury (direct settlement EOA): Option B direct on-chain USDC settlement of commercial issuer clearance (Option A is a formal commercial invoice). An externally owned account, not a smart-contract wallet; not the x402 payTo.
- Live gateway: https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev (Cloudflare Worker; pricingMode free_launch; x402Versions [1, 2]; PayAI facilitator; maxTimeoutSeconds 60).
- Free launch: every route answers HTTP 200 at $0 with no API key and no wallet (60 requests / minute per caller). The x402 prices below apply only if the operator switches pricingMode to x402_paid.
- x402 v1: network base · amount field maxAmountRequired · challenge in the 402 JSON body · pay with X-PAYMENT · receipt X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE.
- x402 v2: network eip155:8453 · amount field amount · challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 JSON) · pay with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE · receipt PAYMENT-RESPONSE · extensions.bazaar carries a JSON Schema draft 2020-12 schema (https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema).
- Bare probe: A bare GET (no query) or zero-byte POST with no payment header on any paid URL returns HTTP 402 at once: the v1 JSON body (x402Version 1, network base, maxAmountRequired) plus the v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402Version 2, network eip155:8453, amount, extensions.bazaar with a JSON Schema draft 2020-12 schema).
- Settlement: A settled call returns 200 with both PAYMENT-RESPONSE and X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE (base64 {success, transaction, network, payer}). That receipt is the facilitator's settlement assertion bound to the payer; the MCP client checks it against the signed authorization but does not look the transaction up on Base (onchainReceiptVerified: false).
- Gateway settlement guard: In x402_paid mode the gateway verifies every settlement on Base before releasing the product: eth_getTransactionReceipt must show status 0x1 and canonical USDC Transfer(payer -> payTo 0xcA4E2ff22B69A7284210c47BdeE21Aac1269da09) logs summing to at least the route price, and replays are rejected on a best-effort basis (402 replay_settlement_tx) via synchronous same-isolate state and non-atomic eventually-consistent KV used_tx:<txHash>; concurrent cross-isolate races are not globally atomic without Durable Objects. Otherwise the product is withheld: 402 unconfirmed_or_reverted_settlement_tx / insufficient_onchain_usdc_transfer, or 502 settlement_rpc_unavailable when no Base RPC answers.
- Paid routes (GET query or POST JSON body with the same names):
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/check/preflight?chain=ethereum|base&address=0x…: 10000 atomic USDC ($0.01)
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/scan/control-plane?chain=ethereum|base&address=0x…: 100000 atomic USDC ($0.10)
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/scan/timelock-op?chain=ethereum|base&timelock=0x…&opId=0x…: 250000 atomic USDC ($0.25)
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/scan/proposal-diff?forum=aave|euler|morpho|sky&topicId=<id>: 150000 atomic USDC ($0.15)
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/briefs/live-timelocks: 100000 atomic USDC ($0.10)
- Free: GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/health, GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/.well-known/x402, GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/sample/control-plane (/.well-known/x402 is the Bazaar discovery manifest, discoverable: true).

## Sentinel (Phase 2)
- PactaSentinelTripwire.sol: an ownerless, immutable contract granted Morpho Vault V2 isSentinel. Vault owners register rules (predicate module + config, cap id, adapter, liquidity reader). trigger(ruleId) is permissionless but re-checks the broken invariant on-chain in the same transaction, then sets the absolute cap to 0 (committed even if deallocate or the EAS receipt revert), deallocates min(allocation, liquid assets), and sweepRemaining(ruleId) drains the rest as liquidity returns. Zero custody. Predicates: AdminUpgradePredicate, OracleGovernanceSwapPredicate, PausePrivilegeEscalationPredicate, CapSupplyViolationPredicate. Status: built and tested (Foundry, 107 tests incl. invariants and fork tests); not audited, not deployed.

## Governance proposals (from /api/v1/proposals.json)
### aave-25128: [ARFC] Onboard cirBTC on Aave v3 Core and Aave V4 Core
- https://governance.aave.com/t/25128 · direct_target: the asset or market this proposal asks to onboard
- ethereum block 26408330 (0x8efc8256deb932e65b5117f040db264dc8200850636d90eecd5daccb99979f4d) · source /api/v1/onboarding.json circle-cirbtc-eth · brief https://pacta.wtf/briefs/circle-cirbtc-eth/
- Sentinel predicates: AdminUpgradePredicate, PausePrivilegeEscalationPredicate, CapSupplyViolationPredicate
- Upgrade authority: proxy admin() = 0xC9cE…a9BD, EOA (no contract code); 0 transactions sent. Implementation 0x4350…02dd; version() = “2”.
- Operational roles: owner() 0xd501…5182 (EOA (no contract code); 0 transactions sent); pauser() 0xabde…A222 (EOA (no contract code); 0 transactions sent); blacklister() 0xb5BE…1D79 (EOA (no contract code); 495 transactions sent); masterMinter() 0xC0Cc…87A2 (contract (5,346 bytes of code), owner() 0x5183…2256: EOA (no contract code); 9 transactions sent).
- None of these roles sits behind an on-chain TimelockController or multisig contract at the pinned block: upgrade, pause, blacklist and minter configuration take effect in the transaction that calls them. Key custody (HSM / MPC) is off-chain and not observable here.

### aave-25499: [ARFC] Onboard PAXGy to Aave V4 Global Dollar Hub
- https://governance.aave.com/t/25499 · direct_target: the asset or market this proposal asks to onboard
- ethereum block 26408330 (0x8efc8256deb932e65b5117f040db264dc8200850636d90eecd5daccb99979f4d) · source /api/v1/onboarding.json paxos-paxgy-eth · brief https://pacta.wtf/briefs/paxos-paxgy-eth/
- Sentinel predicates: AdminUpgradePredicate, PausePrivilegeEscalationPredicate, CapSupplyViolationPredicate
- owner() of the vault, accountant, teller and manager is the TimelockController 0x0DcC…df08 (getMinDelay() = 86,400s). The RolesAuthority 0xC444…99DD is also owned by it. Owner-only changes (including setManageRoot, which no role holds) therefore wait at least 24 hours.
- Timelock roles (9 events replayed): DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE → 0x0DcC…df08; PROPOSER_ROLE → 0x0000…3f2F; EXECUTOR_ROLE → 0x0000…3f2F, 0x1D60…9312, 0x317e…A024, 0x4143…652C, 0x6Be5…526E, 0xFBf7…1A5e; CANCELLER_ROLE → 0x0000…3f2F.
- Capabilities granted through the RolesAuthority execute with no delay. updateExchangeRate is held by the 3-of-5 Safe 0x0000…3f2F and by 0x1755…4B56 (EOA (no contract code); 8,269 transactions sent). The accountant bounds each update: upper 10004 bps, lower 10000 bps of the current rate, at least 3,600s apart (current rate 1.004425 PAXG per PAXGy; platform / performance fee 0 / 0 bps). In the upstream Veda AccountantWithRateProviders source, an update outside these bounds or sooner than the minimum delay stores the new rate and pauses the accountant instead of reverting (the deployed bytecode was not compared with that source here).
- Full role → capability → holder map below, replayed from 68 RolesAuthority events (blocks 25,740,680–26,408,330). Selectors without a public signature are shown as raw 4-byte values.
- Teller 0x41AB…A6f7: isPaused() = false, shareLockPeriod() = 0s. The previous teller 0x5C43…fe72 is paused (isPaused() = true).

### aave-25902: [Direct-To-AIP] Onboard PT-sUSDe-28JAN2027 to Aave V3 Plasma Instance
- https://governance.aave.com/t/direct-to-aip-onboard-pt-susde-28jan2027-to-aave-v3-plasma-instance/25902 · issuer_control_plane: queued Ethena minting-collateral changes underlying sUSDe

- Sentinel predicates: AdminUpgradePredicate, CapSupplyViolationPredicate
- Ethena (USDe / sUSDe) — EthenaTimelockController 1d delay — queued RLUSD & USAT collateral onboarding [parameter_delta, Sprint 14, block 26406106]: getMinDelay() = 86400s (1d). Operations 0x1fe5e3e892708310bbfcf50efc03a1b8e21e0d0042035d7e8315e0cd5f26d85b (ETA 1794651635, 2026-11-14 10:20:35 UTC) and 0x0ca0fcc4856b87f3df9a74532bd60db58d1310c27c17e7d9bfa8a56846f57a90 (ETA 1794651743, 2026-11-14 10:22:23 UTC) are pending. ## Scope
- Observations of on-chain state at the stated blocks; not code audits, reserve attestations or investment advice.
- Exploit-sensitive vulnerabilities are never published here; they go through Immunefi or Cantina bounty programmes.
- Pacta reads governance forums and never posts on them.
